story: A one-way ride of 240 km, Schelklingen to Schelklingen - roughly 4 h 08 in the saddle. On the way it passes Ödenahlen, Schreckensee, Unteruhldingen-Stollenwiesen and back through Schreckensee. It follows river valleys.
